mostWorthwhile.text: Following weathered basalt into both dissolved ions and solid sediment made the different ways water transports material clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final transport sequence felt somewhat predictable, with only one combination offered at each step.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the combinations followed weathering, transport and settling, although several were the only offered action.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the early sea and its surroundings develop, especially if later combinations connect processes as clearly as weathering and sedimentation did here.
